tbesh_subentries.definition_html:
1) to hunt
1a) (Qal) to hunt
1b) (Poel) to hunt, hunt eagerly or keenly

(Hithpael) take provision
Another spelling of tsa.yar (צָיַר "to take provision" H6737)

strongs_1890.strongs_def: to lie alongside (i.e. in wait); by implication, to catch an animal (figuratively, men); to victual (for a journey)
strongs_1890.derivation: a primitive root; also denominative from H6718 (צַיִד)
